rules: RULES: 1) start every turn with `run`  2) delegate-mode tasks need a real spawn
3) verify after every task (output is captured, claims are not)  4) UI work needs browser-run
5) never hand-edit Plan rows — use complete-task; post-done edits auto-reopen as `amend`
operating_card.stale_cache: PLUGIN: cache {newest_cache} is older than {script} - reinstall with `codex plugin marketplace add <path>` before relying on bundled hook diagnostics.

phase_actions.intake: Resolve every material decision in the Blueprint Intake Decision Record and record explicit assumptions for the rest.
phase_actions.design: Select an original grounded Design Direction, or record the checked capabilities and documented unavailable state.
phase_actions.plan: Create or revise Blueprint.md (with AC-n acceptance criteria), get explicit approval, then a normalized Plan.md.
phase_actions.foundation: Satisfy the approved Foundation Contract before feature work.
phase_actions.build: Build ready tasks — spawn starforge-builder for delegate-mode tasks — then `verify` (and `browser-run` for UI).
phase_actions.review: Spawn starforge-reviewer agents, run `review`, then fix or waive the queue.
phase_actions.deliver: Produce the exact approved delivery result and fresh source-bound delivery proof.
phase_actions.amend_approved: Build the approved packet tasks, repeat their affected proof and review lenses, revalidate delivery, then re-run `done`.
phase_actions.done_complete: Project is complete; publish only if explicitly requested.
phase_actions.done_pending: Run the final completion predicate and resolve any remaining source, proof, or cleanliness blocker.
phase_actions.blocked: Inspect blockers and continue the safest unblocked phase.
phase_actions.fallback: Inspect state and continue the safest unblocked phase.

amend_task.description: Post-completion amendment: re-verify and review the drifted files.
amend_task.verify: set the real verification command for the amended files

remediation: Keep only the canonical GitHub-backed Star Forge marketplace registration.
Review the listed roots, then remove obsolete installs with the Codex plugin commands shown by the marketplace diagnostic.
Reinstall star-forge from https://github.com/khaledayeva/star-forge, then start a new Codex task.
Open /hooks in a new Codex task and review the current Star Forge hook entries.
Remove obsolete trust entries only after confirming their listed source paths are no longer needed.
Choose one supported Mobbin OAuth connection path.
Review and disconnect obsolete Mobbin entries through their owning Codex plugin or app settings.
